hook: Ritualo sits at a position that barely existed five years ago: the combined Chief Data and AI Officer function inside a cabinet-level foreign policy agency. Her career was built entirely on the federal data and performance management side, monitoring and evaluation, division chief, deputy CDAO, making her one of the few senior government AI officers whose path to the role ran through data governance and program evaluation rather than technology procurement.
